title: The Gödelian argument is marred by errors and persuades no one

statements.text: Penrose’s statement of Gödel’s theorem is sound, but his discussion of it contains a number of errors, and the Gödelian argument does nothing to bolster an anti-computational view even for readers who already hold it.

sources.quote: his subsequent discussion of it -- especially in relation to Gödel's own formulation and various of its generalizations -- is unfortunately marred by a number of errors
